## 4. The three limit statements (special attention)

All three confirmed live and handled correctly:

- Dated release: **"the purchase limit has been set to two trees per sale"** → candidate line 58, attributed to the dated release.
- Program page eligibility section: **"Maximum two trees per Surrey address, based on your billing address."** → candidate line 60, attributed to the eligibility section.
- Program page tree-list section: **"Customers are limited to two trees per household for purchase."** → candidate line 60, attributed separately to the tree-list section.

Candidate line 62 states: "Those statements are presented as the City published them. They should not be combined into a larger entitlement across the two sales." No sentence sums, averages, reconciles, or infers a four-tree or cross-sale entitlement. The subtitle deliberately says "up to the limits stated by the City" rather than naming a number. Requirement 4 fully satisfied.

A slight loosening rather than a false claim, and the material cancellation trigger (out-of-Surrey billing address) is conveyed correctly. Optional tightening: "credit card".
